bib.title: Make-A-Scene: Scene-Based Text-to-Image Generation with Human Priors

question: Can text-to-image generation gain controllability, human-perception-aware quality and 512x512 resolution by adding scene (segmentation) tokens, region-aware tokenizer losses and classifier-free guidance to an autoregressive transformer?
hypothesis: Conditioning on scene tokens, adding face/object-aware VQ losses and using classifier-free guidance improves FID and human preference over text-only baselines.
contributions: Scene as a control mechanism complementary to text
Face- and object-aware tokenization with explicit losses on key image regions
Classifier-free guidance adapted to transformers, removing post-generation reranking
512x512 generation with state-of-the-art FID and human evaluation

method.summary: A 4B-parameter GPT-3-style autoregressive transformer over [text, scene, image] token sequences. Scene tokens come from VQ-SEG (a VQ-VAE over panoptic, human and face segmentation plus an edge channel); image tokens come from VQ-IMG (VQGAN with face- and object-aware feature-matching losses). Classifier-free guidance is applied on logits.
method.task: text-to-image generation with optional scene layout

datasets.name: CC12m, CC, subsets of YFCC100m and Redcaps (transformer)
MS-COCO
datasets.split: validation text prompts; train-vs-val ground-truth FID as loose lower bound

models.name: Make-A-Scene scene-based transformer (256 and 512 variants)
models.tokenizer: BPE for text; VQ-SEG for scene; VQ-IMG for image

other.segmentation categories: mp=133 panoptic, mh=20 human, mf=5 face, +1 edge channel

other.reranking: self-reranking of 60 used for qualitative figure 2

models.name: GLIDE, LAFITE, XMC-GAN, DM-GAN(+CL), DF-GAN, AttnGAN

training.objective: Autoregressive next-token loss with image:text token loss ratio 7/1; VQ-SEG adds weighted BCE (face parts weight 20); VQ-IMG adds face-embedding and VGG feature-matching losses on top of VQGAN losses

other.classifier-free fine-tuning: text tokens replaced with padding with pCF=0.2 in the last 30k iterations
other.512 model: VQ-IMG gets an extra down/up-sample layer; object-aware loss applied to 512 model only

inference.decoding: Sample next token from the top half of logits by probability, softmax, multinomial; guided logits used for scene and image tokens

metrics.name: FID
metrics.definition: Frechet Inception Distance over 30k images generated from MS-COCO validation prompts, no reranking; (filt.) = model trained without MS-COCO train set

metrics.name: Human preference (image quality, photorealism, text alignment)
metrics.definition: Percentage of majority votes in favour of Make-A-Scene in pairwise AMT comparison; 500 image pairs per question, 5 evaluators each, 2500 instances

eval.protocol: Pairwise AMT human evaluation plus FID on MS-COCO val prompts; no seeds or significance tests stated

limits: No code, weights or data release stated; compute and hardware not given
No seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests
Human evaluation and FID compare against baselines of different training data; DALL-E is the authors' own re-implementation
Lowest FID is attained by the 256 model while humans favour 512
Scene categories are fixed; absent categories (mouse, lion) need substitute classes
Ablation rows are cumulative so effects are order-dependent
